contact.title: Contact me
contact.intro: If you have questions about my products or would like to commission a particular piece please send me an email or drop me a message on Instagram.
contact.note: I will endeavour to reply to you within 48hrs.

about.name: Amanda Gratwick
about.p1: We spend our childhood being told to colour inside the lines, but through life I've discovered that all the best stuff happens when you venture outside the lines.
about.p2: I’m Amanda Gratwick, the maker behind Outside The Lines Studio, based in Sandbanks where I spend my life either in the ocean, whether that's floating on a flat calm surface or kitesurfing in a wild and stormy environment, or recreating it in different forms in my studio, bringing a little bit of both the wild and the peace that the roll of the ocean provides.

ordering.title: How ordering works
ordering.intro: Choose your item, range and edge finishing.

steps.title: Choose a piece
steps.text: Pick your item, and which shape and size you would like. Next choose which range; Ocean, Mountain or Sunset and finally, if you have picked a serving board or platter, choose a flowing resin edge or clean wood all round. Where relevant, personalise your product.

steps.title: Buy or place an order
steps.text: If your item is available in the range and edging you would like press 'Buy Now' and it will be added to your basket and you can securely checkout. If the item is currently out of stock, please place a pre-order to secure your item in my next series.

steps.title: Postage and Payment
steps.text: Choose whether you would like your item to be posted to your door or to an InPost locker to be picked up at your convenience (handy if it's a secret gift for someone in your household!). Then complete your payment by card, Apple or Google Pay.

steps.title: We pack and post
steps.text: Once we receive your order, it will be packed up and posted within 2-3 day. If it is a pre-order, you will be notified when your piece has gone into production and then packed and posted!

hero.lead: Beautiful handmade products in olive wood and resin, in Ocean, Mountain and Sunset ranges. No two items the same so no-one will ever have another piece like it.

faqs.a: Choose a piece, pick your size and edge finish (resin edges or clean edges) and press 'Buy Now', then go to your basket and choose whether to have your item delivered to your door or an InPost locker to collect at your convenience. If the item is out of stock you can press 'Pre-order' to secure it in the next series.

Yes. Every piece is handmade, so the olive wood, colours and shape of the resin change from one to the next. The pictures on the site are illustrations of each type, your piece will have a design of its very own.

faqs.q: Why can I choose my edge finish?
faqs.a:
I create two different finished edges to choose from
Resin edges: the resin flows off the board and coats the edges, so the effect wraps right round the edge. Clean edges: the olive wood edges stay natural all the way round and the resin is kept to the surface. You choose between the two from the Edge finish drop-down on each board and platter. And if you can't decide between the two, order one of each!

faqs.q: What are the Ocean, Mountain and Lava ranges?
faqs.a: Ocean pieces use teals and deep blues with white wave lines. Mountain pieces have layered black mountain ridges with white snowy caps. Lava pieces have have gorgeous reds, blacks and golds flowing across them. All ranges are available in Ocean but only select pieces are avaiable in the other two ranges so please check each item to see your options.

faqs.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: You can choose to pay via care, ApplePay or GooglePay

faqs.q: Can I use my board or platter for food?
faqs.a: Of course! Your boards and platters are perfect for serving food on as we only use a food safe resin and the olive wood has naturally occurring antibacterial properties. What's more we only resin one side so the reverse side of your board is perfect for chopping on if you want to use it to its full potential. It is important however that you don't use a sharp knife on the resin itself as it will scratch.

faqs.q: How do I look after my piece?
faqs.a: Resin is hardwaring and heat resistant so feel free to use your board over and over but wood does not like water so please don't put any of your items in the dishwasher or leave them to soak in water for a long time. Every once in a while your serving boards and platters will need a drink so just coat them in a little oil (any food oil works perfectly) and watch them come back to life!

faqs.q: Can I order a custom size, shape or colour?
faqs.a: Yes! I love a custome commission. If you have something specific in mind or would like to know some options please drop me an email and we can discuss your piece or pieces!
I do not! But I do draw beautiful ocean themed greetings cards so you can pop on or a pack to your order and know you have the card covered!

faqs.q: How much is delivery and how long does it take?
faqs.a: Delivery price depends on the size of the piece you order and if you want it delivered to your door or an InPost locker to collect at your convenience (very handy if you're trying to hide it from someone in your house!). When you come to checkout your basket your postage options and prices will be shown. All postage is fully insured. We aim to post everything within 2-3 days and delievery is usually around the same. If the item is out of stock and you are making a pre-order you will be notified when you piece is back in stock and packaged and posted.

faqs.q: What if my order arrives damaged or I change my mind?
faqs.a: If your item arrives damaged, please take pictures and let me know as soon as possible. All items are fully insured so I will arrange a return for the piece and either a replacement or refund. I don't take returns for a change of mind however.
